description: Embark on an unforgettable overnight sail, including a visit to historic Egmont Key, soaking in the sunset on the water, and anchoring near the charming Anna Maria Island. After a day of adventures, enjoy dinner and activities on the island before returning to Second Wind to rest. In the morning, have the option for an early morning coffee and breakfast on Anna Maria Island before starting our sail back to Treasure Island. Max: 6 Guests
